summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, reporting routine board and auditor changes. The board appointed Erez Simha as Chairman and Rafia Abdulla Mohamed Saeed AlMulla as an independent director. Committees were reconstituted. CBIZ CPAs was appointed as the new independent auditor, replacing Reliant CPA PC, with no prior disagreements. These are standard governance updates, not a forced departure or special situation. The filing also incorporates by reference into existing registration statements.
